name: Supreme Commander Rhaegon Torr-Kai
role: Supreme Military Commander of the Separatist Confederation
notes: Military leader of the Separatist Confederation. Documented in Roster 18.3. Highest L2 crisis escalation score at Turn 184 (sunk_cost_fallacy modifier: 0.386).
alias_drift_note: Draft surname "Voss" (sim-log "Separatist Diplomatic Summit") = canonical "Torr-Kai", same Separatist Supreme-Commander office. Registered by L2 Character Salvage Pass 2026-07-21.

location_binding.basis: Office-holder binding. Canon establishes the office (Supreme Military Commander of the Separatist Confederation, separatist_confed) but names no seat, vessel or world where this character is located. The Union capital is referenced only as 'the capital planet' (Marshal Academy charter) and has no location entity; no polity seat entities exist either.
location_binding.why_not_invented: Binding to an invented seat would fabricate a canonical place. C1 requires the one-body-one-place question to be ANSWERED; an explicit undetermined binding answers it honestly, the same way canonical_position_status: unplaced and route_exemption do.
location_binding.resolves_when: A seat-of-government / duty-station location is established in canon (queued as l2-seat-of-government-locations), at which point type/target_id are filled in.
